definitions.gloss: book collection; library holdings; one's books
definitions.explanation: Books owned by a person or institution. Refers to the collection as a whole rather than individual volumes.

examples.japanese: {蔵書|ぞうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{千冊|せんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: My book collection exceeded a thousand volumes.

⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蔵書|ぞうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{初版本|しょはんぼん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A valuable first edition was found among my grandfather's book collection.

notes:
FORMS:
{蔵|ぞう} (to store, storehouse) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (book, writing).

USAGE:
Used for personal or institutional book collections. A slightly formal word, common in library contexts and when discussing large collections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蔵書|ぞうしょ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of books in a collection)
- {蔵書|ぞうしょ}⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧ (book catalog search)
- {蔵書|ぞうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ (to organize one's book collection)
- {蔵書|ぞうしょ}{印|いん} (bookplate, ex libris)
